# THE ATTRIBUTES

*What every card already carries, gathered into one record. Tarot answers
this question with zodiac signs, elements, sephirot and alchemical stages,
each an attribution someone decided. This deck answers it with consequences
of three marks, each one a thing that can be checked rather than argued
with. The instrument that shows this live is [the sheet](/app/luminara-sheet.html);
this chart is its record in words.*

## I · THE DIFFERENCE, STATED PLAINLY

An attribution is a decision. Somebody assigned Aleph to path eleven, the
Emperor to Aries, and another tradition could assign them elsewhere without
being wrong in any checkable sense: the correspondence lives in agreement,
not in arithmetic.

Every quality below is not that. It is read off a card's own three marks,
still, moving or turning, field to core, by a fixed derivation that produces
the same answer every time it is run. The standing law already refuses the
other kind: no Kabbalah, rune or tarot mapping is imported, under the
interference principle that combining systems degrades readability. What
follows is what was already there to find instead.

## II · WHAT EVERY CARD ALREADY CARRIES

**The marks and the code.** Three symbols, dot, bar or wave, read field to
core. Everything else is downstream of these and only these.

**The knot, T(p,q).** The marks vote into two numbers: q the signed count,
nine, three and one weighted field to core; p the winding, one more than the
layers that moved, seven when all three did. The strand wound p times one
way and q times the other is the card's shape, and the sheet's glyph draws
it exactly.

**The interval.** What the card sounds, read from p:q as a musical ratio.
It belongs to the *dyad*, not the card: a counter negates the count and the
interval reads its size, so a card and its answer always sound the same
note. Thirteen axes, twelve intervals and silence.

**The kind and the strands.** A *circle* closes without crossing (the Seed
alone). A *coil* winds but never knots. A *knot* is one strand genuinely
tied. A *link* is several separate rings, bound only by each other. Six
cards are links, in three counter-dyads: the Surgeon and the Witness, the
Labyrinth and the Mask, each three rings; the Void and the Spectrum, seven.

**The genus.** How knotted, nought to thirty-six. Links and coils are
nought by definition; a strand that never crosses itself has no genus to
measure.

**The clarity.** The interval's own consonance, one for the crisp and
closed, down toward nought for the far dissonances. Exactly three cards
stand at 1.000: the Seed, the Void and the Spectrum. Seven rings sounding
one tone is as clear as silence.

**The piece, in the cube.** Where the card sits in the living cube: the one
*core*, six *centres*, twelve *edges*, eight *corners*. The corners are the
restless eight, and their dyads are the cube's four body diagonals.

**The house, the metal, the hand.** AUM, MA or RA; bronze, silver or gold;
still, flowing or turning. The oldest attributes on the sheet, and still
derived rather than assigned.

**What it answers.** Its counter, the involution: negate every mark and the
card you reach is the one this card answers.

**What it becomes.** Resolve every turning mark to the stillness it was
turning toward. Eight cards are already settled and become nothing.

**Where it falls, and what it receives.** Follow becoming to its end and
every card lands on one of eight roots. Only seven cards receive anything
at all; twenty are pure sources. The Scar sends nothing and receives
nothing: settled, so it becomes no card, and unreachable, since resolving a
turning mark cannot create a moving one. The deck's one true isolate.

**Its name in the mathematical literature.** T(p,q) is a torus knot or
link, catalogued or not. The trefoil, the first knot in every textbook,
arrives exactly four times, all in AUM. The Depth and the Threshold are
8₁₉, the first knot in the tables that cannot be drawn alternating. The
Scar and the Return stand at seventy-eight crossings, past every table.
Crossing numbers by Murasugi's formula; a link's components pairwise linked
pq/g² times.

**Its figure and its tone.** The sand figure standing behind the knot,
three rings on the 3·6·9 ladder, one per layer. And the tone those rings
would sound, measured against the deck's own ground at G: the Resonance
sounds that ground exactly, 196 Hz to the sixth decimal, the reference
tone of the whole instrument. The Seed alone is silent.

**Its distance home.** Steps to the Seed walking only counters and
becomings: nought, one, seven, seven, twelve, at distances nought through
three. Nothing stands further than three steps from the ground.

**Its seats in the calendar.** Where the year, the month and the hour's own
walk through threes lands on this card's cell. Weather, never a cast; the
seats recur, they do not predict.

## III · WHAT SURFACED IN DERIVING THEM

Findings, not attributions, and each one checked before it is stated here.

A card and its counter always share a sound, because the interval reads the
count's size and the counter only negates its sign.

The links come in three dyads and nowhere else: no card partly links and
partly knots.

Clarity's ceiling is held by exactly three cards, and they are not the
three one might guess from stillness alone: the Seed by having no crossing
to measure, the Void and the Spectrum by having crossings that measure to
nothing, seven rings each linked once.

The Resonance sounding the deck's own ground was not designed. Its essence
already argued against its own muteness, *the fifth needs no
interpretation, it simply rings*, and the sound module was built for an
unrelated reason a full week later. The two met without being asked to.

The Void's essence, *bound by nothing but the shared hole*, describes a
linking number of exactly one before anyone had computed it.

An earlier guess, corrected here rather than quietly dropped: the cinquefoil
and Solomon's link do not appear anywhere in the twenty-seven. The deck's
torus knots are narrower than the family they belong to.

## IV · WHAT THE DECK REFUSES TO HAVE, AND WHAT IT HOLDS OPEN INSTEAD

Two absences, and they are not the same kind of absence.

**The sky is a refusal.** The astrolabe work found that the heavens force
exactly two correspondences, the dark moon as the cycle's own zero and the
full moon as its antipode, and refuse every other alignment tried. There is
no derived zodiac, and the finding is that there cannot be one, not that one
has not yet been found.

**The letters are an open question, not a refusal.** They exist, they are
being audited in the open, and they stand sealed at the keeper's gate until
that audit closes. Nothing above depends on them, and nothing above will
need to change when they are settled.

## PROVENANCE

*Written 27 July 2026 at the architect's word, gathering into one chart what
had been said in conversation about the sheet and building it into words
that stand on their own. Every quality in section II and every finding in
section III is pinned by test, in core/tests/sheet.test.ts and the modules
it draws from; nothing here is asserted without a check that already exists
in the repository. Section IV states an existing refusal (the astrolabe
work) and an existing open question (the letters ledger) side by side so
the difference between them is visible. Letter-free throughout, and it
touches no open grid.*
